yacl3.config.usage-ticker-reloaded.title: Usage Ticker Reloaded Config
yacl3.config.usage-ticker-reloaded.useCo: Use ',' instead of '.' for decimal separator.
yacl3.config.usage-ticker-reloaded.match: Require item NBT to match when counting. For example, enchanted books with different enchantments won't be combined.
